summary.headline: Astrological Chapters on Theft and Prognostication
summary.text: Astrological chapter catalogue entries on ascendant hexagons, lunar and conjunctional centers, wind prognostication, horary beginnings and outcomes, stolen objects and thieves, the inquirer’s question, association and separation, digging wells and pits, and iatromathematical writings attributed to Hermes, Petosiris, and Protagoras, with references to Venetian and Parisian codices.
